# Azure Arc Demo — Estate Overview

*Story-first dashboard modelled on the persona-led flow. Tiles below open the conversation from exec down to ops.*

content.query:
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, OSType
| extend Status = iff(LastSeen > ago(10m), 'Connected', 'Stale')
| summarize Hosts = count() by Status, OSType
| order by OSType asc
content.title: Estate connectivity (last 15m)

content.query:
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize HostsBeating = dcount(Computer) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Hosts beating over time (24h)

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and CounterName has 'Processor Time' and InstanceName == '_Total'
| summarize AvgCPU = avg(CounterValue), MaxCPU = max(CounterValue), P95 = percentile(CounterValue, 95) by Computer
| order by AvgCPU desc
content.title: Per-host CPU utilisation (24h)

content.query:
ConfigurationChange
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Changes = count() by Computer, ConfigChangeType
| order by Changes desc
content.title: Configuration changes (24h)

content.query:
ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType == 'Software'
| where SoftwareType == 'Application'
| summarize Installed = dcount(Computer) by SoftwareName
| top 25 by Installed desc
content.title: Top 25 applications across the estate

content.query:
resources
| where type == 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| extend hasOwner = tobool(tags.owner != ''), hasCostCenter = tobool(tags.costcenter != '')
| summarize Total=count(), Tagged=countif(hasOwner and hasCostCenter)
content.title: Tagging hygiene (Arc machines)

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and EventLevel <= 2
| summarize Critical = countif(EventLevel == 1), Errors = countif(EventLevel == 2) by Computer, EventLog
| order by Critical desc, Errors desc
content.title: Critical & Error events (Windows, 24h)

content.query:
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and SeverityLevel in ('err','crit','alert','emerg')
| summarize Events = count() by Computer, Facility, SeverityLevel
| order by Events desc
content.title: Linux syslog errors (24h)
